wrap.en: So, to wrap things up, even a couple of years ago, nuclear power was a story about a fight between the past and the future: old reactors closing in Europe while new ones opened in Asia.
wrap.zh: 总而言之，就在几年前，核电还是一个关于过去与未来博弈的故事：欧洲在关闭旧反应堆，而亚洲在开启新反应堆。

writer.en: But the food of ordinary people continued to be based on local ingredients and traditional recipes By the 18th century, some British writers were already complaining about this trend, criticizing wealthy British people who preferred French cooks to English ones.
writer.zh: 但普通人的食物继续以本地食材和传统食谱为基础。到了18世纪，一些英国作家已经开始抱怨这种趋势，批评那些宁愿要法国厨师也不要英国厨师的富有英国人。
